translationRepairs: In Dazhun 2 Vice Minister Pei Zan placed him eighth on the list; the roster was posted on the tenth day of the first month—Xunhe's own birthday.
In Dashun 2 Vice Minister Pei Zan placed him eighth on the list; the roster was posted on the tenth day of the first month—Xunhe's own birthday.
Focus unit opens 大順二年; 大順 is the Tang reign Dashun, so idiomatic Dazhun is a false romanization. Dashun matches the Chinese and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
At the fifth watch they halted at Baima post, summoned civil and military officers to eat; because the following ministers were not assembled, the procession halted to wait;
At midmorning they halted at Baima post, summoned civil and military officers to eat; because the following ministers were not assembled, the procession halted to wait;
Focus unit begins 禺中; that classical time term means midmorning, not the fifth watch (五更). The proposed literal reading matches the Chinese and the already-correct idiomatic rendering.
When Cheng Yan took Jingzhou he made Ting his chief secretary; Ting delayed some time before accepting.
When Cheng Rui took Jingzhou he made Ting his chief secretary; Ting delayed some time before accepting.
Focus unit names 成汭; 汭 is ruì, so Cheng Yan is a wrong romanization. Cheng Rui is the correct personal name and the rest of the proposed sentence is accurate.
